qualification: uefi-x64's platform on a disk declared for 128 MB of flash, with its own kernel configuration and declared reserves. Current signed file deployments: required signed root/support verity, authenticated metadata and component installation. QEMU runtime, component updates, trial fallback and fault recovery pass. This does not qualify physical firmware, flash endurance or hardware-rooted debug policy. Development signing inputs only; conservative I1 board grade retained pending physical/operational qualification.

evidenceRefs.ref: mica-build:src/cli.ts verify --board mini-x64; current signed file-image checks

physicalBoundaries.jtag: Generic PC platform; Mica OS specifies no JTAG/SWD port and controls none -- debug exposure is defined by the platform owner's hardware and firmware.
physicalBoundaries.serialConsole: Present where the platform exposes one, with a login prompt only; no account accepts a credential (mica:docs/design/access.md section 2).
physicalBoundaries.recoveryPath: Whole-disk reflash from external boot media through the machine's own UEFI firmware; open to physical access by design (mica:docs/design/security-model.md section 1).
